purpose: Produce a local or synthetic Change Candidate only when Work Order and Capability Grant candidates agree.

success_conditions: Work Order, grant, target revision, produced artifacts, and observed effects remain exactly bound
negative_tests: missing grant, expired authority, revision drift, or unexpected effect fails closed

rollback.action: discard the local Change Candidate and apply the Work Order rollback if an effect occurred
rollback.verify: candidate artifacts and observed effects match the rollback receipt
